summary: Draws an int field as a Layer dropdown.
overview: Put it above an int and the Inspector shows the layer picker instead of a number, so nobody has to remember that layer 9 is Interactable.
useCases: A layer index field that should be picked, not typed.
Avoiding a wrong layer number that fails silently at runtime.

gotchas.title: A layer index, not a LayerMask
gotchas.body: They are different things. A mask is a bitfield of many layers; this picks one index. Use a LayerMask field when you mean several.
